prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Pet's Journey", "Browse different companion paths to find the experience that fits your desktop style best.", "Path Selector"]
1: ["Keep Your Pet Safe Across Devices", "Signing in links your pet data and unlocked items to your account so you never lose progress.", "Continue to Sign In", "Use your primary login to restore any existing pet automatically."]
2: ["Pet Photo Creator & Live Preview", "Upload a clear front-facing photo to generate your 3D desktop pet.", "Upload Photo", "Live 3D Rendering"]
3: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Right-click your pet on the desktop or use the taskbar tray icon anytime to minimize, feed, or chat.", "Got It!"]
4: ["Welcome Back to Desktop Pet", "Already adopted a pet before? Sign in with the same email to restore your companion instantly."]
5: ["Initializing Desktop Companion Environment", "Preparing pet graphics in your desktop tray. If hidden, click the tray arrow on your taskbar."]
6: ["Select Your Path & Unlock Starter Items", "Choose a path now to claim a free hat and toy pack for your desktop pet.", "Includes Free Welcome Starter Kit"]
7: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your desktop pet a name and stamp your official adoption paper.", "Pet Name", "Official Adoption Seal"]
8: ["How Would You Like to Start?", "Pick Quick Match to adopt instantly, or Custom Creator to craft a pet. You can change this anytime later.", "Takes less than 1 minute to complete."]
9: ["Your Pet is Live on Your Desktop!", "Your desktop companion is now active. Use shortcuts or double click to interact.", "Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to show or hide your pet on screen!"]

verdicts.problem: Asks for personal information (a photo of the user).
